about: Rival personas for race/tools/rival_gen.py. Global knobs only: never tune per course. envelopeFrac scales every envelope limit (Vmax, accel, decel, n, roll rate); gateWindow is the usable fraction of each gate radius (at most 0.9: a line never grazes a gate edge); speedCap scales Vmax on top of envelopeFrac. --calibrate fits envelopeFrac per persona so the median of rival time / human record hits calibration.targets.

personas.name: STEVE
personas.blurb: Sunday driver: flies every gate dead centre, never above 85% of top speed.

personas.name: BRAT
personas.blurb: Fast, sloppy: halfway to the optimal line, and runs wide on 2 gates every lap.

personas.name: MOO
personas.blurb: Fully optimized line inside the middle 60% of each gate.

personas.name: DAWG
personas.blurb: Fully optimized, 98% of the envelope, but never uses the outer 30% of a gate. Humans can.
